patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) From the game install folder, navigate to 'www' -> 'img' -> 'pictures' Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the downloaded patch archive somewhere Run the 'SplitOfKnight.exe' program, select the '(Y)' button, use the folder selector to find the 'pictures' folder prev
